scope: A numerical policy-and-transition model with executable durable admission, not Kubernetes binaries. Phase count is the number of independently safe guard regions needed for an explicit endpoint target; it is not a claim about kubeadm speed, available capacity, quorum, node draining, webhook safety or real installation downtime. The official control-plane-before-worker order and one-control-plane-at-a-time workflow are existing mechanisms, not contributions of this study.
